Reasoned is a native Android learning app licensed AGPL-3.0-only, using LearnHarness teaching instructions. Third-party components retain their own licenses. It is not an official LearnHarness or OpenAI app.

Sessions and learning preferences stay in app-private storage on this device. Credentials use Android Keystore-backed encryption and are excluded from backup.

Starting a turn sends your goal, answers, preferences and session context directly to the provider you select: OpenAI by default, another listed provider after you save its API key, or a custom endpoint you configure. A custom endpoint is operated by you or a third party and may retain data independently. API-key requests use API billing; ChatGPT requests use the chosen plan’s allowance or credits. No automatic billing fallback. Long sessions automatically summarize older context with an extra request on the same model/connection, retaining the full local history. Invalid question/plan calls can be corrected with at most two extra attempts; permission, replay and provider/transport failures are not automatically retried.

Where a provider supports it, requests disable response storage, but this does not guarantee zero provider retention; each provider’s policy applies. Keep the session in the foreground while generating. SVG figures use a separate bounded write/render/visual-review loop on the same model and billing; its brief and locally rendered PNG are sent to that provider. Model-reviewed does not mean independently verified. Opening saved diagrams is offline and never regenerates them.

Your graph stores extracted propositions and reasoning chains with links to their source messages, not mastery assessments. Extractor/Auditor make additional requests using the session’s selected model and billing; processing stops when the app leaves the foreground. The separate sample graph is illustrative.

Practice saves model-committed solutions, learner submissions and model verdicts locally; these are not mastery certificates. With your per-session permission, Researcher sends self-contained questions and public-page excerpts to the selected model. Brave receives search queries and has separate key/billing; without its key only known public links can be read. Visited sites see requests from this device, never app account cookies. Reports, read URLs, retrieval dates and bounded excerpts stay in the session. Web text cannot grant tools or permissions. No PDF, background browsing or private-network access.
